## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: low overall breadth (3/11) and concentration of gains in a few Technology names while most cyclical and defensive sectors are negative, producing mixed signals.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare and Materials follow modestly (Healthcare: AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY; Materials shows small breadth lift). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy, Utilities and Real Estate are weakest: VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION, NEE (1W: -5.46% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND, CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND; Financials and Industrials also showing downside pressure.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentrated: Narrow (4/5 Technology); style: mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth outside Tech.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND, MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION, CCI (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication, Technology midcap software and select Energy/Real Estate names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; watch SHOP (1W: +10.70% | 1M: -5.35%) RECOVERY and AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY for short-term mean-reversion versus structural uptrends.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech shows concentrated strength but mixed internals: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +31.13%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -7.91%) BELOW TREND. Sector positive on 1W returns but internals narrow; treat recent rallies as momentum-driven rather than broad-based.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak on 1W: JPM (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -5.91% | 1M: -9.47%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -4.30%) BELOW TREND. Sector showing distribution and contributing to the mixed NEUTRAL regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare modestly positive: LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +7.51% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY. Leadership in pockets (FDA-driven names) but overall breadth is uneven.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to leading Technology beaters (QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor Healthcare catalysts (LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY); reduce exposure to the weakest communication and large-cap services names showing clear downtrends (CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -26.63%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -9.04% | 1M: -20.26%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +5.64%) given concentrated leaders; BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +1.13%) and Utilities (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -6.85%) where weakness is broad.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
QCOM breakouts above recent highs (watch consolidation above +10% 1W moves) could extend momentum; AAPL (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND is a bellwether for Tech risk appetite; watch CHTR downside continuation for Communication sector stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+90): Eli Lilly (LLY) wins two FDA approvals and a major alliance — price RECOVERY: LLY (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -0.50%) RECOVERY confirms news-driven buying. WBD (+85): Warner/Paramount headline with acquisition context — WBD (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND confirms accumulation. QCOM (+60): Qualcomm patent license news aligns with strong price action — QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND confirming sentiment.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
VLO (-45): Energy export concerns match price weakness and short-term pullback — VLO (1W: -6.32% | 1M: +11.25%) CORRECTION shows divergence between 1W pain and 1M strength. MPC (-45): Diesel export scrutiny aligns with short-term selling — MPC (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +8.63%) CORRECTION. BA (-50): Boeing software glitch headlines amplify downside risk—BA (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND confirms negative sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak breadth (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive). QCOM (1W: +13.65% | 1M: +24.03%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +39.39%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership and news-driven rallies (LLY, WBD, QCOM) may not be broad-based—watch for follow-through or distribution.
